maintenance_led.reason: Sells hormone pellets, training and nutraceuticals to providers for patients' elective hormone optimization; not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from provider clinics and cash-paying patients buying hormone pellets and supplements, not government programs.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by expanding its certified provider network and selling pellets and nutraceuticals, not through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Elective wellness therapy; providers could source other compounded hormone pellets, though Biote training adds some stickiness.

notes: Mission-critical is borderline because trained providers and ongoing patients face moderate switching friction.
